rule.timing: Post-hoc exploratory decision after new-family and combination results; explicitly requested by user.
rule.comparison: IDW is the common strong anchor; GP, v4 and v6 remain fully reported references.
rule.profile_and_thickness: Both below IDW; no minimum percentage improvement.
rule.spatial_consistency: At least 3 of 4 unique sites improve continuous error.
rule.non_dominance: Non-dominated among all current and historical fixed models on E,H,point BER,risk BER.
rule.reason: Observed useful frontier trades small identification changes for profile/thickness gains; retain explicit small error tolerances instead of a large percentage hurdle.
rule.interpretation: Promoted for continued development and frozen independent evaluation; not proven generalization.
rule.specialist: Remaining Pareto candidates are retained for their explicit tradeoff, not declared overall winners.
